item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:50 HKT 12/Jun/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The area of low pressure now over the northern part of the South China Sea will move eastwards across the region slowly tomorrow. Under the influence of the area of low pressure and its associated trough of low pressure, there will be heavy showers and squally thunderstorms over the northern part of the South China Sea. The weather will be very hot over the coast of Guangdong with a few showers and thunderstorms. The southwest monsoon is expected to become active midweek this week. The weather will be unsettled over the coast of southern China with occasional heavy showers and thunderstorms. Under the continuous influence of the monsoon, there will still be a few showers over the coastal areas during the weekend. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Guchol will move across the seas south of Japan today and tomorrow and transform into an extratropical cyclone gradually.

Weather: Very hot with sunny periods with a few showers. Isolated thunderstorms later.
